rv.q: Slam Frank is a bucking bronco in a world of pony rides. But if you can hang on till the end, you might find that getting knocked around can jostle new things loose.
Slam Frank takes aim at pretty much everyone and everything, and about 50 percent of the shots hit their targets.
Theater 'Slam Frank' lampoons wokeness with jackboots and rap verses while testing the limits of taste (Off Broadway review) Date: October 4, 2026. Author: Thom Geier Taste is subjective.

cn.t: This audacious satirical musical reimagining Anne Frank as a queer Latinx rapper divides critics with its provocative lampoon of wokeness—some find it an equal-opportunity offender that tests taste limits, others see undeniable comedic fearlessness.
